reason: A DSH server-side plugin that monitors workflow and approval events and surfaces completion, failure, interruption, and permission alerts through macOS or Linux desktop notifications.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 监控任务、工具、目标、工作流和审批事件，并通过 macOS 或 Linux 桌面通知显示完成、失败及审批提醒。
summaries.en: A DSH server-side plugin that monitors task, tool, goal, workflow, and approval events and displays completion, failure, and approval alerts through macOS or Linux desktop notifications.

capabilities: Displays operating-system notification banners and modal alerts
Monitors DSH session, task, tool, goal, workflow, and approval events
Invokes macOS osascript or Linux notify-send for notifications
Plays sounds for selected modal alerts
